snippet.title: Maid Cafe on Electric Street - INDIE Live Expo Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming to Steam in Summer 2024!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789030/_/

Maid Cafe on Electric Street is a leisurely maid cafe adventure set in the otaku haven of Nipponbashi, Osaka.

Visit real-life locations such as Surugaya, Sofmap, Super Potato, and more with four cute and colorful maids!
